## Boundary decisions (owned — ADR-0295)

- `independent` computes over declared identity material, fail-closed:
  `attestation.anchor.signer` on both provenances AND
  `installation_id` on both instruments must resolve and BOTH differ;
  anything else computes `false` with the basis recorded on
  `evidence.independent_basis`. Cryptographic *establishment* of the
  reproducer's claim (§05g "attested distinctness") stays with
  OQ-334 → the C2/Stage-5 `reproduced`-status work (S5.4).
- `verdict` derives from `outcome` at serialisation — one source of
  truth (CC1), interim `outcome` member retained (CC8).
- `repro_report.bundle_id` must equal the transition's `bundle_ref` —
  a report is evidence for its named bundle only.
- `lab.leaderboard.snapshots` reads the persisted per-definition index
  `snapshot_leaderboard` appends to — oldest first; no new semantics.
